questions.scenario: Your housing society is organizing a massive Sunday cricket tournament. What is your main job?

options.A: I am on the ground early, setting up the stumps, drawing the boundary with chalk, and sorting the bats.
options.B: I am looking at who scored what in the last tournament to decide a logical, winning batting order.
options.C: I am designing a cool WhatsApp poster for the tournament and hyping it up in the society group.
options.D: I am collecting the 'chanda' (entry fee) from every flat and deciding how the prize money will be split.

questions.scenario: It is the IPL Mega Auction day and you are watching it live on TV.

options.A: I am jumping around the living room, celebrating loudly whenever my favorite team buys a star player.
options.B: I have a notepad open, calculating my team's remaining purse money and analyzing which bowler they need next.
options.C: I am checking Instagram and Twitter to see the funniest memes and cool welcome reels for the new players.
options.D: I am imagining myself at the table, aggressively raising the paddle and negotiating to get players at base price.

questions.scenario: Your friends are obsessed with making a Dream11 fantasy team for tonight's match.

options.A: I skip the app entirely and tell them to come downstairs to physically play a real match instead.
options.B: I spend 30 minutes analyzing the pitch report, weather conditions, and head-to-head stats before picking my captain.
options.C: I pick players based on their current hype, aesthetic 'vibe', and who has the coolest batting style.
options.D: I organize a private contest among friends, collect the entry fees on Google Pay, and manage the winner's pot.

questions.scenario: It is the Annual School Sports Day. How are you contributing to the chaos?

options.A: I am helping the PT teacher carry the shot put balls, setting up the race tracks, and moving the heavy VIP chairs.
options.B: I am sitting at the score desk with a stopwatch, accurately noting down race times and calculating house points.
options.C: I am painting the house flags, choreographing the march-past, and clicking aesthetic action photos of my friends.
options.D: I am the House Captain, strategically assigning which student runs which race to maximize our chances of winning the trophy.

questions.scenario: A massive fight breaks out over a 'no-ball' decision during a gully cricket match.

options.A: I grab a bat and physically measure the crease line on the road to resolve the fight immediately.
options.B: I recall the exact ICC rules and previous match incidents to logically prove whether it was a no-ball or not.
options.C: I take out my phone and record the whole hilarious argument to post it as a funny reel later.
options.D: I step in as the neutral umpire, calm everyone down, and negotiate a 'dead ball' compromise to restart the match.

questions.scenario: You are at the local sports shop to buy a new Cosco ball and a cricket bat.

options.A: I take the bat out of the plastic immediately to practice shadow-batting and test its physical swing.
options.B: I carefully compare the weight, willow thickness, and handle grip to see if it matches my specific batting style.
options.C: I am already thinking about how to customize the bat with cool stickers, neon grip tape, and my initials.
options.D: I aggressively bargain with the shopkeeper uncle to get a 15% discount and an extra free ball with the bat.

questions.scenario: Your favorite Indian athlete suddenly goes completely out of form and keeps failing.

options.A: I practice their exact bowling/batting action in front of the mirror to figure out what they are doing wrong physically.
options.B: I dig into their recent strike rate, footwork data against spin, and averages to find the root cause of the failure.
options.C: I make a heartfelt, emotional fan-edit video on Instagram with sad music to show them support.
options.D: I discuss with my friends how this bad form will negatively affect their brand endorsements and sponsor deals.

questions.scenario: You and your friends want to book a turf for playing box football or cricket this weekend.

options.A: I take responsibility for bringing the actual football, the pump, and making sure everyone has proper sports shoes.
options.B: I check the distance of three different turfs, comparing travel time versus play time to find the most logical spot.
options.C: I suggest what matching color t-shirts everyone should wear so our group photos look amazing after the match.
options.D: I collect everyone's share of the booking money on UPI and call the turf owner to negotiate a cheaper hourly rate.

questions.scenario: You are stuck at a boring family wedding while a crucial India vs Pakistan match is live.

options.A: I sneak out to the parking lot with my cousins to play a quick physical game of catch instead of just watching.
options.B: I constantly refresh Cricbuzz to check the current run rate, bowler economy, and win-probability graphs.
options.C: I only check Instagram for the hype moments, best catches, and stylish slow-mo sixes.
options.D: I place a friendly bet (like treating the loser to a shawarma or cold drink) with my cousin on who will win.

questions.scenario: When you think about your dream job in the sports industry, what excites you the most?

options.A: Being right there on the ground, feeling the live stadium energy, and making sure the mega-event runs perfectly.
options.B: Sitting behind the scenes with a laptop, finding hidden talent, and outsmarting the opponent with pure data.
options.C: Building the team's massive brand, designing iconic jerseys, and making the players look like global superstars.
options.D: Wearing a sharp suit, closing multi-crore brand deals, and running the entire sports franchise like a boss.

Event_Operations.title: The Stadium Boss (Event Operations & Logistics)
Event_Operations.primary_match_text: You are high-energy, active, and practical! You don't just want to watch the match; you want to make it happen. You are the backbone of any mega sporting event.
Event_Operations.day_in_the_life: Running around huge stadiums before a big IPL or ISL match. You manage the equipment, coordinate with security, ensure the pitch is ready, and make sure the live event goes off without a single flaw.
Event_Operations.alternative_match_text: If not this, you'd make a great Event Manager, Logistics Head, or Tournament Director.
Event_Operations.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream. College: BBA, B.Com, or BA. Professional: Pursue a specialized Post Graduate Diploma or MBA in Sports Management & Event Operations from institutes like NASM or IISM.

Sports_Scout.title: The Stat Master (Sports Data Scout / Fantasy Analyst)
Sports_Scout.primary_match_text: You are analytical, observant, and love numbers! While others watch the ball, you watch the player's technique. You have a sharp eye for spotting hidden talent.
Sports_Scout.day_in_the_life: Sitting behind multiple screens, analyzing player statistics, pitch conditions, and match footage. You help sports franchises decide which unknown player to buy in the auction, or work for massive fantasy sports apps.
Sports_Scout.alternative_match_text: If not this, you'd make a great Data Analyst, Statistician, or Strategy Consultant.
Sports_Scout.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce with Maths or PCM (Science). College: B.Sc Statistics, B.Sc Sports Science, or B.Tech. Professional: Learn Python/SQL and do a Certification/Diploma in Sports Analytics.

Sports_Marketer.title: The Hype Creator (Sports Marketer / PR Executive)
Sports_Marketer.primary_match_text: You are creative, expressive, and know how to capture attention! You understand the emotion of Indian sports fans and know how to make a player look like a hero.
Sports_Marketer.day_in_the_life: Designing team jerseys, creating viral Instagram reels, managing a star cricketer's social media accounts, and coming up with the catchiest slogans for the team's new marketing campaign.
Sports_Marketer.alternative_match_text: If not this, you'd make a great Social Media Manager, Brand Manager, or Public Relations (PR) Head.
Sports_Marketer.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream (Arts/Commerce preferred). College: Bachelor of Mass Media (BMM), BA in Journalism, or BBA. Professional: MBA in Sports Marketing or Digital Marketing.

Franchise_Manager.title: The Deal Maker (Sports Agent / Franchise Manager)
Franchise_Manager.primary_match_text: You are a natural leader with a sharp business mind! You love the game, but you love the business behind the game even more. You know how to negotiate and win.
Franchise_Manager.day_in_the_life: Sitting in the boardroom or the VIP box. You negotiate multi-crore contracts for star players, talk to big brands to secure jersey sponsorships, and manage the overall budget of a sports franchise.
Franchise_Manager.alternative_match_text: If not this, you'd make a great Talent Agent, Business Head, or Corporate Negotiator.
Franchise_Manager.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce (preferred). College: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) or B.Com. Professional: MBA in Sports Management from a top tier institute and studying Sports Law.
